personality_one_liner: A fresh, trustworthy, and highly intuitive green-themed interface that makes laundry logistics feel as clean as the service itself.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical padding, avoid dense dashboards. Ensure safe areas are respected and touch targets are minimum 44pt.

do's: Apply to bottom tab bar and sticky headers over scrolling lists
Apply to Bottom-sheet handles / headers on the map tracking screen
Ensure text on glass uses onSurface and background is properly tinted
dont's: Do not apply glass to list rows or dense form inputs
Do not over-stack blur effects (max 2 per screen)

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Minimal authentication via phone number and password.

states.error: Toast or inline message for invalid credentials.

screens.layout: Centered logo at the top with a subtle green tint background or photo backdrop (using gradient scrim). Clean, single-column input form (Phone Number, Password) with a prominent sticky primary button at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Home (Customer)
screens.purpose: Dashboard to view points, current active order status, and start a new laundry order.

states.loading: Skeleton loader for the active order card and points.
states.empty: Illustration of clean clothes if no active orders.
states.error: Error loading dashboard data with a 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Top section features a Loyalty/Points card (showing current points and 'X points to free kg'). Below that, an 'Active Order' glassmorphism tracking mini-card if an order is active. The main area is a grid (flexWrap with space-between) of laundry item categories (Karpet, Kaos, Kemeja...) using tinted icon containers (brandTertiary bg) allowing users to tap to start an order.

screens.name: Order Creation & Options
screens.purpose: Select item quantities and delivery options, simulating checkout/payment.

states.error: Validation error if no items selected.

screens.layout: Scrollable list of items with +/- steppers to specify quantities. Below the items, a segmented control or toggle card for 'Pickup & Delivery' vs 'Drop-off at Branch'. A sticky primary CTA fixed at the bottom displaying total price to proceed to Payment Simulation.

screens.name: Order Tracking & Map
screens.purpose: Live map of courier with a vertical timeline of order statuses.

states.loading: Map loading state and skeleton timeline.

screens.layout: Top half of the screen is a full-bleed map simulating a moving courier route. The bottom half is a @gorhom/bottom-sheet containing a vertical timeline (Diterima -> Lunas -> Dicuci -> Disetrika -> Siap diambil/diantar -> Selesai). Includes a button to leave rating/comments once 'Selesai' is reached.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Manage all customer orders and update their statuses.
screens.layout: List of active orders grouped by status. Each row shows customer name, item count, and a dropdown or quick-action button to progress the status (e.g., mark as 'Dicuci').

hero_login.alt: Clean folded white clothes stack representing fresh laundry

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality. Use the provided green-forward palette (`brand: #059669`) consistently for all primary actions and indicators.
Implement a robust vertical timeline for the order tracking screen. Use distinct statuses: Diterima, Lunas, Dicuci, Disetrika, Siap diambil/diantar, Selesai.
Ensure map integration correctly simulates tracking a courier route during the delivery phases.
On the Home Screen, prominently feature the Loyalty Points balance (1 kg = 1 pt, 25 pts = 1 free kg) in a lifted `surfaceSecondary` or `brandTertiary` card.
Ensure the quantity selector (steppers) for items like Karpet, Kaos, Kemeja are user-friendly with min 44x44pt touch targets.
Use a gradient scrim (top to bottom, transparent to `surfaceInverse`) over any background photos like the login/hero screen so text remains fully legible.
For the admin side, keep the layout functional and list-focused so status transitions are 1-tap away.
